answer: Identity-bond natural decay stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks a 200-credit bond in a vault for 20 epochs; it decays 5% each epoch unless the agent does useful work. Each record is marked in sable ink, so one history cannot be copied across accounts. A timber shed full of fakes still needs one bond each: 100 fakes cost 20,000 credits plus 2,000 lost to decay, far above one reward. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
